questions.text: To confirm: temporary approval is granted automatically when the tenant submits the onboarding form at first sign-up, even with no certificate uploaded. So this flow starts at 'upload certificate' and then goes to Super Admin review, then Ratified or Stopped. Is that right?

Is there a deadline for uploading the certificate while the hospital is temporarily approved (for example, 30 days)? If it passes with no upload, what happens: nothing, reminders only, or service stops automatically?
questions.answer: 30 days is a good time, u can start reminders at 20 days, hard reminders 25 days onwards i.e intermittent stoppings

questions.text: What does 'stopped' mean for the hospital's users: fully locked out, read-only (can view and export existing patient data but not add new records), or something else? Is existing patient data kept?
questions.answer: read only can remain for another 30 days and after that complete lock

questions.text: If the Super Admin rejects the certificate, can the tenant upload a corrected one for another review, or is 'stopped' final unless the Super Admin reverses it? Should the Super Admin enter a reason that the tenant can see?
questions.answer: Super admin should be able to confirm this certificate from website, mail, hard letter or RTI. and reject it after that only and ofcourse tenant can put corrected one - 30 days will be counted from rejection

questions.text: How is the tenant told about their status (Temporary / Under review / Ratified / Stopped): only in the app, or also by email/SMS? And once ratified, can the tenant replace the certificate (for example, when it is renewed), and does that trigger a new review?
